sources.title: GitHub - eosphoros-ai/Awesome-Text2SQL: Curated tutorials and resources ...
sources.snippet: The eosphoros organization proposes an open source project focusing on Text-to-SQL fine-tuning based on LLM, including large-scale model download, dataset preprocessing, fine-tuning technologies such as LoRA and QLoRA, model prediction, model evaluation and other steps.

sources.title: I Fine-Tuned a 3B Model for Text-to-SQL and It Actually Works
sources.snippet: The model gets pulled about 15-25 times per day without any active promotion. I think it mostly shows up in HuggingFace search results for "text-to-sql" and people grab it to test.

sources.title: Text-to-SQL with LLM & AI: Complete Guide to Tools and Frameworks
sources.snippet: October 28, 2025 LLM & AI Models for Text-to-SQL: Modern Frameworks and Implementation Strategies Large language models have transformed text-to-SQL technology. Learn how frameworks like LangChain, Instructor, LlamaIndex, and Snowflake Cortex Analyst enable natural language database queries, plus emerging techniques and implementation best practices.
